narrative:
The FY2026 Integrated Business Plan starts from EUR 15.1B of FY2025 net sales, read directly from S/4HANA ACDOCA through Datasphere zero-copy — no BW E0P extract and no manual re-keying. The top-down ambition is EUR 15.6B (+3.1%) on the way to the EUR 16B group target.

Cooking and Dishwashing (Bosch, Neff, Gaggenau built-in) carry the margin; Laundry and Refrigeration carry the volume. Europe remains ~60% of sales, while Rest of World (Turkey, India, Latin America) grows fastest at +8.5% and China is planned slightly down.

The cascade below replaces the manual target split in SAC: change any category or region total and the plan re-allocates instantly by AI-forecast weights, then writes back to SAC as the planning frontend.

signals.title: BP Process Overview — Manual Entry Hotspots
signals.excerpt: Every step of the business planning process involves manual data entry or adjustments in SAC and Excel. Actuals are re-keyed from BW E0P; volume and price assumptions are emailed between controllers.

signals.title: F&C Workshop Munich — UDP Evaluation
signals.excerpt: ~30 F&C stakeholders reviewed ACDOCA access, real-time P&L, Material Ledger and Cortex Analyst. Priority: replace BW E0P, keep SAC as planning frontend, single source for actuals.

signals.title: European Home Appliance Market Outlook
signals.excerpt: European MDA market flat to +1% in 2026 after two years of decline; premium built-in segment recovering faster than freestanding. China competition intensifying in entry price points.
